parts.text: I have been working at Altostrat for 8 years and I work 12-hour shifts. How many vacation days do I earn per year, and how many vacation days do I log to take a single 12-hour shift off?

Accrual tiers: 1-6 years = 20 days, 7-10 years = 21 days, 11+ years = 22 days. 8 years falls in the 7-10 tier => 21 days/year. A vacation day is an 8-hour block, so a 12-hour shift = 1.5 vacation days.

Sources: 1.2, 20.2

parts.text: I have been at Altostrat for 3 years, received a 'Significant Impact' GRAD rating, and want to take 45 days of continuous unpaid personal leave. I currently have 15 days of accrued vacation remaining in my balance. Can my direct manager approve this unpaid leave today?

Unpaid time off exceeding 30 days is reclassified as Personal Leave (up to 92 continuous days). Personal leave requires approval from both Manager AND Director (so direct manager approval alone is insufficient). Furthermore, the handbook specifies that employees should have fewer than 10 vacation days remaining before unpaid personal leave is approved. With 15 vacation days left, the employee must utilize vacation days first.

Sources: 3.3, 18.2

parts.text: My wife and I both work at Altostrat in Singapore. We just welcomed a newborn. If I (the father) allocate 2 weeks of my Shared Parental Leave to my wife, how many weeks of Baby Bonding Leave do I receive?

Baby Bonding Leave is 18 weeks. Section 26.3 (Singapore Shared Parental Leave Scenarios, effective April 1, 2026) is the governing Singapore-specific rule: when both parents are Altostrat employees, the father's Baby Bonding Leave remains 18 weeks and is NOT reduced by the SPL sharing arrangement. Therefore the father still receives 18 weeks. (The older global Section 2.2 mentions a 16-17 week reduction, but the Singapore-specific 26.3 governs here and applies no reduction.)

Sources: 26.3
